inputs.label: Baa corporate spread
inputs.desc: Moody's Baa yield minus the 10-year Treasury (BAA10Y)

inputs.label: Aaa corporate spread
inputs.desc: Moody's Aaa yield minus the 10-year Treasury (AAA10Y)

inputs.label: Commercial paper spread, nonfinancial
inputs.desc: 3-month AA nonfinancial CP minus the 3-month T-bill

inputs.label: Commercial paper spread, financial
inputs.desc: 3-month AA financial CP minus the 3-month T-bill

inputs.label: Commercial paper outstanding (slower growth = tighter)
inputs.desc: minus the year-on-year % change in CP outstanding (COMPOUT)

inputs.label: Bank business loans (slower growth = tighter)
inputs.desc: minus the year-on-year % change in commercial & industrial loans (TOTCI)

inputs.label: Banks tightening business-loan standards, large & mid firms
inputs.desc: Senior Loan Officer Survey, net % tightening (DRTSCILM)

inputs.label: Banks tightening business-loan standards, small firms
inputs.desc: Senior Loan Officer Survey, net % tightening (DRTSCIS)

inputs.label: Weaker business-loan demand
inputs.desc: minus the Senior Loan Officer Survey net % reporting stronger demand (DRSDCILM)

inputs.label: Nonfinancial corporate debt (slower growth = tighter)
inputs.desc: minus the year-on-year % change in nonfinancial corporate debt securities and loans (Fed Z.1, BCNSDODNS)

inputs.label: Real fed funds rate
inputs.desc: effective fed funds minus core PCE inflation over the past year

inputs.label: Flatter yield curve (2s10s, inverted)
inputs.desc: minus the 10-year minus 2-year Treasury spread (T10Y2Y)

inputs.label: Real 30-year mortgage rate
inputs.desc: Freddie Mac 30-year fixed rate minus core PCE inflation over the past year

inputs.label: Mortgage rate spread to the 10-year
inputs.desc: Freddie Mac 30-year fixed rate minus the 10-year Treasury

inputs.label: Stock-market volatility (VIX)
inputs.desc: CBOE VIX, weekly average (VIXCLS)

inputs.label: Stronger dollar
inputs.desc: year-on-year % change in the Fed's broad trade-weighted dollar (DTWEXBGS, spliced to TWEXB before 2006)

inputs.label: Banks tightening credit card standards
inputs.desc: Senior Loan Officer Survey, net % tightening credit card loans (DRTSCLCC)

inputs.label: S&P 500 below its 12-month high
inputs.desc: % the S&P 500 monthly average price sits below its highest monthly average of the past 12 months (Shiller; entered a month late)

inputs.label: Corporate bond spread incl. high yield (GZ)
inputs.group: Corporate bonds (sub-index only, not the headline)
inputs.desc: Gilchrist-Zakrajšek spread: average spread over matched Treasuries of senior unsecured bonds of US nonfinancial firms, investment grade and high yield (Federal Reserve Board, monthly; entered 40 days after the month starts)

inputs.label: Excess bond premium
inputs.group: Corporate bonds (sub-index only, not the headline)
inputs.desc: the GZ spread net of expected default risk: the price of bearing corporate credit risk (Federal Reserve Board, monthly; entered 40 days after the month starts)

inputs.label: Equity risk premium (cheaper stocks = tighter)
inputs.desc: S&P 500 cyclically adjusted earnings yield (10-year average real earnings, entered 6 months late, over the monthly average price, entered a month late; Shiller) minus the 10-year real Treasury yield

inputs.label: Real 10-year Treasury yield
inputs.group: Policy and rates (sub-index only, not the headline)
inputs.desc: 10-year TIPS yield (DFII10) from 2003; before that, a stated proxy: the 10-year Treasury minus core PCE inflation over the past year, shifted by the 2003–07 average gap to TIPS

inputs.label: 10-year term premium
inputs.group: Policy and rates (sub-index only, not the headline)
inputs.desc: Kim-Wright 10-year term premium (Federal Reserve Board, THREEFYTP10), weekly average

inputs.label: Banks tightening commercial real estate standards
inputs.group: Context: real estate, consumer credit, loan quality (not in the headline)
inputs.desc: Senior Loan Officer Survey, net % tightening CRE loans (DRTSCREL to 2013Q3; then the average of construction, nonfarm nonresidential and multifamily: SUBLPDRCSC/N/M)

inputs.label: Business loan delinquency rate
inputs.group: Context: real estate, consumer credit, loan quality (not in the headline)
inputs.desc: delinquency rate on business loans, all commercial banks (DRBLACBS), seasonally adjusted; entered 150 days after the quarter starts

inputs.label: Credit card delinquency rate
inputs.group: Context: real estate, consumer credit, loan quality (not in the headline)
inputs.desc: delinquency rate on credit card loans, all commercial banks (DRCCLACBS); entered 150 days after the quarter starts

inputs.label: Commercial real estate delinquency rate
inputs.group: Context: real estate, consumer credit, loan quality (not in the headline)
inputs.desc: delinquency rate on CRE loans excluding farmland, all commercial banks (DRCRELEXFACBS); entered 150 days after the quarter starts

inputs.label: Bank reserves (smaller share = tighter)
inputs.desc: minus reserve balances with Federal Reserve Banks (H.4.1, WRESBAL) as % of commercial banks' total assets (H.8, TLAACBW027SBOG); from 2009, the ample-reserves regime

inputs.label: Overnight reverse repo cushion (smaller = tighter)
inputs.desc: minus the Fed's overnight reverse repo take-up (RRPONTSYD) as % of commercial banks' total assets; from the facility's start in Sep 2013. Money funds' cash parked at the Fed is the buffer that balance-sheet runoff drains before it drains bank reserves, so a smaller cushion reads as tighter

inputs.label: Repo rate over the Fed's floor (SOFR minus IORB)
inputs.desc: SOFR minus the interest rate on reserve balances (IORB; IOER before 29 Jul 2021), weekly average, bp; from April 2018. No free general-collateral repo rate exists before SOFR

inputs.label: Bank lending to nonbank lenders (slower growth = tighter)
inputs.desc: minus the year-on-year % change in commercial banks' loans to nondepository financial institutions (H.8, LNFACBW027SBOG; one-off reclassification jumps chain-linked out) · since 2016

labels.gz: Corporate bond spread incl. high yield (GZ)
labels.sloos_cre: Banks tightening commercial real estate standards
